title: Desert Tracks ABC
hook: Desert friends walk on with me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: sunny 3D desert storybook, sand gold and sky blue, friendly wildlife, soft cactus shapes, crisp isolated subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a gentle field-guide walk following tracks, shade, plants and desert wildlife
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: memorable two-line thematic reset with child-compatible echo
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 uses heat, shade, tracks, spines, stone and animal motion as concrete images, with short lines beside longer scene phrases.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses short search cues, one recall beat and a safe motion—step, glide, point, spread, trace or sway.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
